meta.title: SPEED RUN — Hapcheon Meteor Crater Paragliding Open
meta.description: One rule only: come back faster than anyone. SPEED RUN is a pure paragliding time attack over Korea's only confirmed meteor impact crater.

hero.sub: Two hundred million years ago, a meteor built this circuit. A pure time attack above the Chogye Basin — Korea's only confirmed meteor impact crater.

circuit.label: THE CIRCUIT
circuit.title: A circuit built by a meteor
circuit.lead: The Chogye Basin in Hapcheon is Korea's only scientifically confirmed meteor impact crater. Launch from the Chogye site, clear every waypoint around the basin, and return. No engine — only wind, judgment, and your line.

classes.label: CLASSES
classes.title: Three classes, one circuit
classes.lead: Pilots compete on the same circuit in three classes by wing certification.

b.name: EN-B
b.desc: Stability-focused intermediate wings. Where first-time circuit challengers start.

c.name: EN-C
c.desc: The balance of performance and stability — where the record hunting gets serious.

d.name: EN-D / CCC
d.desc: Top-tier competition wings. Circuit records are set here.

leaderboard.label: LEADERBOARD
leaderboard.title: Season leaderboard
leaderboard.lead: Every flight is GPS-verified, and the standings can flip at any moment all season long.
leaderboard.sampleNote: ※ Times shown are sample standings for the current season

season.label: SEASON
season.title: The circuit stays open until the record falls
season.body: SPEED RUN runs as a season, from spring to late autumn every year. Attempts are unlimited — come back and fly again as many times as you want. When the season closes, the fastest pilot is the season champion.
season.b1: GPS trackers with real-time live-track verification
season.b2: Official timing judged by a panel of three
season.b3: Class podiums plus an overall season champion

ctaBand.title: The circuit is open

about.heroSub: A paragliding time attack over Korea's only confirmed meteor impact crater.

venue.label: VENUE
venue.title: The venue — Chogye Basin, Hapcheon
venue.p1: Formed by a meteor impact roughly 200 million years ago, the Chogye Basin is Korea's only scientifically confirmed impact crater. The ridgeline around the basin and the fields inside it form a natural stadium.
venue.p2: Pilots launch from the Chogye site, clear the waypoints set across Chogye-myeon and Jeokjung-myeon, and return to the landing zone. Reading the basin's thermals and wind lines is what makes a fast time.

task.label: TASK
task.title: The task — 11 waypoints
task.p1: The race is a pure time attack. Launch, clear all 11 designated waypoints in order, and the fastest pilot back wins.
task.p2: Tasks are set by turn direction and lap count — LEFT ×1 / LEFT ×3 / RIGHT ×3 / RIGHT ×1. Every flight is recorded by GPS tracker and verified in real time on the live track.

rules.label: RULES
rules.title: Entry requirements
rules.lead: Safety comes before the stopwatch. Every requirement below must be met before you fly.
rules.r2: Officially certified wing matching your class
rules.r6: Signed waiver, privacy and filming consent
